properties.name: Strength
properties.description: The melee attack and damage stat: the longsword and the staggering blow.

properties.name: Dexterity
properties.description: The ranged and finesse attack stat: the goblins' weapons, the crossbow and the hunter's flurry roll with it, and the hunter's flurry adds it to damage.

properties.name: Constitution
properties.description: Adds to what a rally restores to the creature it is used on.

properties.name: Maximum hit points
properties.description: A copy of the hit points' maximum, which no expression can read; bloodied reads this instead. Keep the two equal.

properties.name: Armor Class
properties.description: The defense a weapon attack rolls against, unless the power names another.

properties.name: Fortitude
properties.description: The defense the staggering blow attacks instead of Armor Class.

properties.name: Reflex
properties.description: A defense declared for later powers; nothing attacks it yet.

properties.name: Will
properties.description: A defense declared for later powers; nothing attacks it yet.

properties.name: Hit points
properties.description: A creature's hit points; every statblock sets their current value and maximum. At half or below the creature is bloodied, at zero it is dying, and healing clears each again.

properties.name: Flurry uses
properties.description: What the hunter's flurry, the one encounter power here, spends. Only a creature with that power needs it, one use a fresh encounter, and nothing here refills it.
